en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course builds on Basics of GIS, expands GIS knowledge in the sphere of geographic information systems, introduces more complex analytical operations focused on the practical use of GIS in fields related to the field of study (topography, hydrology, erosion processes).
